黑碳（soot）落在冰雪上为什么会加速融化？

Why does black carbon (soot) on snow and ice speed up melting?

黑碳颜色深、吸光强，降低冰雪反照率，使其吸收更多阳光升温；它还能促进冰内吸热与早期融水，放大北极与高山冰川的退缩。
Black carbon is dark and absorbs light, lowering ice albedo so it soaks up more sun and warms; it also promotes internal heating and early meltwater, amplifying Arctic and mountain glacier loss.

甲烷的“短期气候强迫”为什么让快速减排甲烷格外关键？

Why does methane's 'near-term climate forcing' make rapid methane cuts especially urgent?

甲烷在大气中约 12 年就被分解，远低于 CO2 的百年尺度，因此近期减甲烷能迅速压低升温速率，是给气候“刹车”见效最快的手段之一。
Methane breaks down in about 12 years versus CO2's centuries, so cutting it now quickly slows warming rate—one of the fastest-acting climate 'brakes'.

氢经济里“绿氢、蓝氢、灰氢”怎么区分？

How are green, blue and grey hydrogen distinguished in the hydrogen economy?

灰氢来自化石燃料且无碳捕集；蓝氢同样来自化石但配套 CCS；绿氢用可再生电力电解水制取，全程近零排放，是脱碳的“理想氢”。
Grey hydrogen comes from fossil fuels with no capture; blue hydrogen adds CCS; green hydrogen is made by electrolyzing water with renewable power—near-zero emissions, the ideal clean H2.
